meal.title: What We'll Build: Slot‑Machine Deposit Overview
meal.objective: Understand the overall goal of the slot‑machine deposit program

voice.script: What if you could turn a simple deposit into a slot‑machine game? That hook grabs your curiosity. A project is the complete application you are creating, everything from asking for money to showing a spin. A script is a single Python file that runs the steps of that project. Our goal is to build a program that asks for a deposit, lets you choose how many lines to bet and how much to wager, prints a summary of the bet, and then displays a random slot‑machine spin. This gives you a clear picture of what the finished app will do.
